pulls.title: Record exact validation scope for the merged column-overlap theorem
pulls.body:
## Purpose

Merged PR215 introduced the full-channel column-overlap theorem. This follow-up preserves its exact local validation evidence and distinguishes the historical tested snapshot from later integrated main inventories.

No mathematical claim, proof, verifier, witness, source pin, or test implementation changes.

## Evidence recorded

- The historical b0ccaa3 snapshot has exactly 903 unique test IDs: 879 retained passing baseline tests with unchanged code, 18 fresh shared tests, and six fresh column-overlap tests. The receipt excludes all eight A4-only IDs from the imported baseline.
- A separate exact replay reproduces all seven retained controls byte-for-byte, covering 4,277 target coefficient positions and 23,722 source-slice positions.
- Baseline provenance points to the immutable published receipt at commit798cf02ffc87e59c7b33dab9866b7b777779e733.
- Integration with main6e11f7c discovers 906 test IDs. Integration with current main a510bec discovers 916 IDs across 212 modules. Both receipts explicitly distinguish discovery from execution.
- Six focused tests and all 18 shared tests passed freshly after each integration. The ten new quadratic-biform IDs are recorded as discovered, not claimed as executed here.
- Every historical receipt and all theorem, source, report, and test bytes remain unchanged. Current main's quadratic work is preserved exactly.

This is documentation and receipt maintenance. The historical 903-ID union is baseline-plus-delta evidence, not a fresh full-suite run. Neither the complete regression nor the archive replay was repeated locally. Hosted CI remains the separate merge gate.

```sh
python -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_column_overlap.py -v
python -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_research.py -v
```

The updated VALIDATION note explains the retained baseline and exact exclusions. Claim `AI-PAIRED-COLUMN-OVERLAP-001` remains written and unreviewed.

pulls.title: Construct pruned 22-product bounds and prove aggregation cost limits
pulls.body:
## Problem and result

The prior aggregation work still charged the entire leading grid. It left open whether unequal target shapes or smaller centered supports could make the displayed construction pass the direct 9/4 cost comparison.

This PR adds a constructive smaller-support bound and proves precise limits of that approach. It restricts the externally credited general22 graded construction to 22 product-dependent rectangular targets, each of volume n^5. For every integer n >= 2 over characteristic zero,

`border_rank(direct_sum of the 22 targets) <= 4n^5 + 32n^4 + 102n^3 + 158n^2 + 118n + 34.`

The leading aggregate uses `4n(n+1)^4` positions. The polynomial includes every nonzero correction position and is strictly smaller than the classical upper bound `22n^5` for every n >= 4. At n = 4 the two counts are 21,850 and 22,528.

This is a border-rank construction and a comparison with the stated classical bound. It does not assert optimal rank, a stable runtime with the same cost, or an improved exponent.

## Why the exponent comparison still fails

- **Arbitrary fixed rectangular shapes:** the complete-grid budget exceeds the required sum of target volumes to the 3/4 power for every fixed part-size shape through 32 coordinates. The exact certificate covers 1,238 unordered shapes through dimension 32, plus 108 dimension-33 controls. Dimension 33 is only a non-exclusion boundary.
- **Fixed-form rigidity:** if one target fills the full centered coordinate spaces, projecting to it forces each prescribed leading-grid coefficient to remain one (or 1 + O(lambda) for a degeneration).
- **Pruned mixed shapes:** if the two active maps in each coordinate of dimension m share at least m + 1 nonzero rows, merely deleting identically zero positions still costs at least `(4/3^(3/4))^d * max_t(volume_t^(3/4))`. This rules out the direct 9/4 comparison for the investigated 10-, 13-, 22-, 29-, and 106-product families.

These are limitations of displayed position budgets under explicit hypotheses, not lower bounds on actual tensor rank. New linear forms, cancellation among nonzero positions, and embeddings with fewer common nonzero rows remain open.

A concrete separated-centering embedding violates the common-support premise. Bounded modular searches for that alternative are retained with their exact scope; they produced no competitive accepted construction and do not establish characteristic-zero impossibility.

## Evidence and reproduction

- The exact verifier checks all 13,845 ordered triples of the external general10/general13/general22 inputs, including their signed grades.
- Every surviving term has the claimed cancellation or positive total grade. The proof explicitly retains the ambient correction coefficient q = n + 1 when some local target dimensions are one.
- Exact symbolic counts apply to every n; separate literal-grid enumerations at n = 2 and n = 3 check the counter.
- Five rectangular and six pruned focused tests passed. The retained 920-ID evidence is baseline-plus-delta coverage for its named historical tree, not a fresh complete regression on this PR.
- Fresh integration checks passed all 18 shared tests after merging current main a510bec. A separate preservation audit retains all 89 aggregation-package files, all three aggregation test modules, all eight new quadratic artifacts, both protected archives, earlier receipts, and the exact 306-object claim union.
- All remote trees are checked against the reviewed local trees. Hosted CI must pass before merging.

```sh
python -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_aggregation_rectangular.py -v
python -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_aggregation_pruned.py -v
python -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_research.py -v
```

The package READMEs give the exact replay commands and historical validation provenance.

## Claims and source credit

New claims are `AI-AGGREGATION-RECTANGULAR-GATE-004`, `AI-AGGREGATION-FIXED-GRID-005`, `AI-AGGREGATION-PRUNED-SUPPORT-006`, and `AI-AGGREGATION-PRUNED-RECTANGLES-007`, all written and unreviewed.

Solomonik and Bläser, [arXiv:2610.26563v2](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26563v2), retain credit for the aggregation framework, general22 tripartitions, signed grades, and correction sets. The new contributions are the smaller embeddings, exact counts, and scoped cost deductions. Both manifests preserve all nine source declarations; five raw files are retained and rehashed, while four older declarations remain metadata-only pins.

The branch incorporates the preserved dependency head from superseded PR212, then the separate rectangular, constructive, audit, and integration commits. It includes main a510bec and preserves the concurrent column-overlap and quadratic-biform work. It does not change the closed source PR or consolidation PR214. Same-session audits are not independent mathematical review.

pulls.title: Exclude all constant compressions in the fixed two-sided A4 family
pulls.body:
## Research result

The fixed two-sided A4 conjugation family had one remaining necessary condition: constant long-leg compressions would have to remove at least nine limiting slice directions to support the full M(10,10,11) target.

This continuation proves that every constant compression removes at most eight. Over C, every rank-26 pair satisfies

`dim(P E C) >= 38`

for the specified 46-dimensional outer space. The imported low-rank reduction then gives dimension at least 104 for every constant rank-110 compression of the full 112-dimensional limit, while the target requires dimension at most 103. Arbitrary Laurent first maps and re-saturation are included.

The proof closes constant compressions in this one fixed conjugation family. Moving compressions and other singular paths remain open. It neither constructs a full target nor improves the matrix-multiplication exponent. The lower bound 38 is not asserted to be sharp.

## Proof and acceptance evidence

- A torus degeneration reduces arbitrary flags to 2,809 graded budget pairs while retaining arbitrary subspaces within each weight space.
- Exact linear equations close 2,781 pairs; quadratic-form bounds close 25 more.
- All 24 retained rational minor identities and nine coupled block identities are reconstructed from the literal source. Explicit shared-flag arguments close the remaining three pairs.
- The separate coordinate census covers all 142,884 independent deletion pairs. Its sharp projected dimension 40 remains stronger within that narrower class.
- Eight acceptance/rejection tests for the universal certificate passed. The retained historical 920-ID receipt is an exact baseline-plus-delta union for its named earlier snapshot, not a fresh full-suite run on this PR.
- After integrating current main a510bec, all 18 shared repository/profile/support checks passed. The committed integration receipt preserves all 3,057 prior-continuation and 2,994 current-main files outside the shared summaries, all 71 existing A4 artifacts/receipts, all eight new quadratic files, and the exact union of 304 claim objects. All 19 A4 source-pin declarations match their 12 distinct input files.
- Hosted CI must pass before merging. Same-session subagent checks do not constitute independent mathematical review.

## Files and reproduction

The main result is in `research/ai/2026-10-23-a4-compression-algebra/proof.md`, with a separate acceptance implementation and retained certificate. Its README and VALIDATION note give exact commands and evidence provenance. Current-main integration receipts keep the older validation scopes explicit.

```sh
python -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_a4_arbitrary_compression.py -v
python -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_research.py -v
```

## Claim scope and provenance

The new claim is `AI-A4-ARBITRARY-COMPRESSION-001`, written and unreviewed. It imports `AI-A4-TWOSIDED-RANKLOSS-001`, `AI-A4-TWOSIDED-LOWRANK-003`, and the credited resolvent minimum-rank result. The sharper finite coordinate claim is `AI-A4-INDEPENDENT-COORDINATE-004`.

The branch starts from main 6e11f7c, incorporates the preserved dependency head 085076a from superseded PR213, and then records separate theorem, scope, validation, and navigation checkpoints. It also merges current main a510bec and preserves its column-overlap, top-coefficient-biform, and quadratic-biform results. It does not alter the closed source PR or consolidation PR214. Every published tree is checked against its reviewed local tree before the branch update.

pulls.title: Consolidate research branches with preserved evidence and recovery tags
pulls.body:
## Why

Parallel research branches contain overlapping packages, claims, and validation receipts. This PR consolidates their recorded work into one reviewable tree, preserves exact source versions and attribution, and replaces superseded source PRs.

## Changes

- Consolidate **138 topic branch names, 170 archived source snapshots, and 613 claims**. The [branch manifest](https://github.com/1337isnot1337/matrix-mult-bounds/blob/dcd18b0cb9cc00b8a7394f78b36d53c7e35d6b82/docs/consolidation/2026-10-23/branches.json) records exact heads, PR metadata, and recovery tags.
- Preserve distinct implementations, tests, certificates, and historical archives. Reconcile shared summaries without dropping scope corrections. The [guide](https://github.com/1337isnot1337/matrix-mult-bounds/blob/dcd18b0cb9cc00b8a7394f78b36d53c7e35d6b82/docs/consolidation/2026-10-23/PUBLICATION.md) and [resolution manifest](https://github.com/1337isnot1337/matrix-mult-bounds/blob/dcd18b0cb9cc00b8a7394f78b36d53c7e35d6b82/docs/consolidation/2026-10-23/central_resolution_manifest.json) explain selection and conflict decisions.
- Integrate current main `6e11f7c1`, including the independently merged PR215 and PR217 contributions already captured in this consolidation. Preserve concurrent `5d144109` and `434178af` separately from the topic-snapshot count. The oblique claim correction retains a universal lower bound with equality for the supplied attaining map.
- Include the finite-field interpolation continuation and the general quadratic two-index slice-rank package. Keep D > 0 explicit in the fixed-factor corollary, earlier attribution, and unreviewed status. Reconcile its stale README pin while preserving the exact original pin and source evidence. Keep the full Python matrix, archive replay, and auxiliary Lean build.

## Validation

| Local stage | Result |
|---|---|
| Full baseline | 1,916 tests executed: 1,914 passed; two stale dependency-pin checks failed. Both pins were repaired with original metadata retained. |
| Repair and package follow-up | All 29 checks passed. |
| Eight-head catch-up | All 33 checks and the standalone quadratic equal-degree verifier passed. |
| Prior closure metadata | Both checks passed. |
| Five-head gate at `72f5c524` | All 28 checks passed. |
| Claim/link checks at `33a0f407` | Both checks passed. |
| Interpolation/metadata gate at `147db331` | All four checks passed. |
| Quadratic follow-up at `0bddc6e8` | All eight checks passed in 2.272 seconds: six package tests plus claim-ledger and relative-link checks. |

The final listed inventory is **1,957 tests across 438 modules**. Coverage combines revision-specific stages; there has been no uninterrupted local full-suite run on the final tree. The [evidence index](https://github.com/1337isnot1337/matrix-mult-bounds/blob/dcd18b0cb9cc00b8a7394f78b36d53c7e35d6b82/docs/consolidation/2026-10-23/packaged_evidence_index.json) preserves each receipt and its scope.

**Final-head hosted CI remains required:** all eight Python 3.10/3.14 jobs, archive replay, and Lean. Current-main and review gates also apply before merge.

## Research status and cleanup

Claims retain their evidence and review statuses. Consolidation establishes no exponent improvement or independent mathematical review. Lean covers the auxiliary finite-slope lemma; the complete scalar-profile proof remains outside that formalization.

Verified cleanup so far: **131 source branches deleted and 102 source PRs closed as superseded**. **PR215 and PR217 actually merged independently** and are recorded separately.

PR218 advanced to `80bd2ae6` just before the final retirement check, adding a structural quadratic-index sequel. Its earlier `c7b7257b` source is included here. The new head is now separately archived and remains on its branch while the sequel is integrated and checked. Retirement requires matching archives and ancestry, fresh PR/protection checks, no open head/base dependency, and expected-SHA deletion leases. Original bodies, ready/draft and auto-merge metadata, and temporary publication holds remain preserved. Advanced heads are retained.

Final verified retirement result: **131 source branches deleted; 102 source PRs closed as superseded. PR218 and its newly advanced source branch are retained.**.
